sectors.trend: Big four banks advance on ASX as bond yields ease; however, IMF pressure for spending cuts and soaring state interest costs (headline 48) create fiscal headwinds. Bathla insolvency storm (60) and private credit concerns (57) signal credit stress.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from yield curve easing but face NPL risk from insolvency wave. Monitor credit spreads.

sectors.trend: WA exploration pipeline strong: Dalaroo copper-nickel-PGE, Critica 58% rare earths carbonate, Augustus 30g/t gold. Gold boosted by easing oil and Treasury yields. Franco-Nevada nears all-time highs. AUD weakness supports commodity exporters.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX benefit from AUD softness. Junior explorers (Dalaroo, Critica, Augustus) offer asymmetric upside. Gold miners (Nevada Gold, Regis) supported by safe-haven flows.

sectors.trend: Middle East oil shock from Saudi pipeline shutdown; diesel crack spreads expanding. Australian fuel distributors face east-coast supply crunch. Coal policy debate (47) and green hydrogen waste (78) create policy uncertainty.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WES.AX (refining) benefit from crack spreads. BHP.AX, WDS.AX exposed to oil volatility. Coal names face policy risk. LNG exporters (Santos, Woodside) benefit from elevated energy prices.

sectors.trend: Coles maintains milk price premium despite axing farmer support (31). Real wages growth crushed by exploited workers (55). Qantas strike risk (22) pressures travel. Tenants see rent relief (42).
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. QAN.AX exposed to industrial action. REITs (GPG.AX, SPG.AX) may benefit from tenant relief narrative.

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn Queensland datacentre deal signals major capex. Labor introduces AI regulation including smart glasses ban (28). King warns of existential AI risks (26). Meta salary war (43) highlights talent competition.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (WTC.AX, XRO.AX) benefit from datacentre infrastructure demand. Regulatory risk for AI hardware. CSL.AX, SVA.AX in healthcare-tech intersection.

sectors.trend: ACCC moves to break real estate agency monopoly (51). Trump mulls policies that could crash Aussie house prices (54). Tenant relief emerging (42). Soaring state interest costs pressure government-backed property.
sectors.implications: GPG.AX, SPG.AX, ICOL.AX face mixed signals: tenant relief positive but rate hike risk negative. Monitor RBA path.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to consolidate near recent highs on bank strength and commodity support, but oil shock volatility and RBA hike risk cap upside. AUD weakness is a double-edged sword. Qantas strike and credit contagion are near-term overhangs. Expect 2-4% range-bound trading.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural tailwinds from WA mining pipeline, AI infrastructure capex, and energy transition support 6-12 month upside. However, IMF-mandated fiscal tightening, potential RBA hikes, and geopolitical oil risk create headwinds. Net: cautiously constructive for materials and energy, cautious for financials and REITs.
